adversarial_direction: Steelman the bull case and test whether Avoid is a false negative.
pre_mortem_narrative: Twelve months later, Avoid failed because Nu sustained Q2-like customer, revenue and earnings growth without a credit deterioration, a defensible group cost of equity proved close to the 9.78% market-implied rate rather than the 16.51% Brazil Investments CGU rate, and successive dual beats moved the stock toward or above the US$18.78 sell-side mean. The engine's mature-bank and high-rate anchors then understated a premium digital lender.
bear_case: Avoid remains credible because every engine fair value is below US$14.30, Q3 consensus requires roughly 42.3% revenue and 39.0% EPS growth, credit-income gains precede the full loss outcome, H1 net income included a US$991.046m deferred-tax benefit, and bank-specific prudential evidence is incomplete.
bull_case_steelman: Nu is not a mature-bank clone: Q2 revenue grew 50.3%, diluted EPS grew 66.3%, customer count reached 139m, activity was 83.5%, FY2025 ROE was 30.3%, FY2026 EPS revisions were 8 up/0 down, and the mean target was US$18.78. If group cost of equity is near 9.78%, US$14.30 is coherent without mature-bank convergence; durable growth and returns could make the engine distribution a discount-rate and peer-selection false negative.
killer_risk: The relevant group-wide post-tax USD cost of equity is near 9.78%, making the high-rate residual-income downside largely an artifact of using a 16.51% Brazil Investments CGU reference.

kill_criteria_attack.criterion: Group cost of equity is 9.78% or lower on a matched group-wide, post-tax USD basis.
kill_criteria_attack.closeness_to_trigger: Partway conceptually, not evidentially: 9.78% reconciles price, but no sourced group build proves it.
kill_criteria_attack.disconfirming_evidence_now: The run itself proves 16.51% is CGU-specific and 9.78% reconciles the same earnings path to market price.

kill_criteria_attack.criterion: Q3 revenue exceeds US$6.11484bn and EPS exceeds US$0.23272 while early delinquency does not worsen.
kill_criteria_attack.closeness_to_trigger: Not measurable before Q3; Q2's dual beat shows the operating path is possible.
kill_criteria_attack.disconfirming_evidence_now: Q2 revenue and diluted EPS grew 50.3% and 66.3%; the credit-quality limb remains unresolved.

kill_criteria_attack.criterion: Two consecutive standalone quarters materially beat frozen revenue/EPS consensus with stable or improving credit metrics.
kill_criteria_attack.closeness_to_trigger: Partway: Q2 beat both bars, Q1 did not, so one successful quarter exists but no two-quarter sequence.
kill_criteria_attack.disconfirming_evidence_now: One dual-beat quarter is visible before the decision date.

kill_criteria_attack.criterion: Matched direct peers justify at least 3.90x FY2027 P/TBV.
kill_criteria_attack.closeness_to_trigger: Far: current matched work supports no more than 2.30x.
kill_criteria_attack.disconfirming_evidence_now: Nu's 30.3% ROE and large growth premium show why a mature-bank set may be too conservative, but they do not prove 3.90x.

kill_criteria_attack.criterion: NU closes at or below US$6.47 while fair value remains US$6.47 and prudential evidence has not deteriorated.
kill_criteria_attack.disconfirming_evidence_now: The market can deliver large upside relative to the engine base before the entry condition fires.

variant_perception_attack.claimed_edge: Credit-income and tax-quality concerns may make the earnings run-rate less durable than headline growth, while price exceeds all engine fair values.
variant_perception_attack.what_would_prove_not_different: A group cost of equity at or below 9.78%, continued dual beats and stable/improving credit would show the premium reflects durable economics. The thesis already states there is no proven variant perception yet.

value_trap_check: The mirror-image value trap is rejecting a premium compounder using mature-bank anchors. Nu's premium can be earned if growth and returns persist at a lower group hurdle, but the run does not prove that across a full credit cycle.
base_rate_check: No adequate empirical reference class in the run measures Nu-like digital lenders sustaining 30%+ returns across a full credit cycle. Both scenario and forecast probabilities are therefore correctly labeled judgment. The explicit 10% US$18.78 tail prevents the downside distribution from excluding the already-visible positive path.
overconfidence_flags: Discount-rate anchoring: 16.51% is concrete but scoped to a Brazil Investments CGU, not the group.
Peer-frame anchoring: mature-bank multiples may understate a faster-growing digital lender's warranted premium.
Confidence is already cautious at 52 with an eight-point single-variable downgrade, so the additional haircut is limited to avoid double-counting.
disconfirming_evidence_present: Q2 revenue and diluted EPS grew 50.3% and 66.3%.
FY2026 revisions were 8 up/0 down for EPS and 5 up/2 down for revenue.
The US$18.78 mean target is 31.3% above US$14.30.
A 9.78% group-implied rate reconciles the same earnings path to price.
FY2025 ROE of 30.3% weakens simple mature-bank convergence.
what_would_change_the_call: A sourced group-wide post-tax USD cost of equity at or below 9.78% would force a valuation rebuild.
Two consecutive material revenue/EPS beats with stable/improving delinquency, credit cost and ECL coverage would weaken the raised-bar thesis.
A matched peer set supporting at least 3.90x FY2027 tangible book would invalidate the mature-bank anchor.
Primary-regulator prudential returns showing comfortable buffers would remove a major uncertainty but not alone close the valuation gap.
notes: This final audit pins the post-propagation decision record, which already records confidence_haircut=5 and post_review_confidence_score=47. It uses only evidence available by 2026-08-31 and does not recommend a less restrictive decision than Avoid.
